name: Thane Hearthless
race: Human (Hearthblood, a distant descendant of Aldrumm)
equipment: Traveler's pack (bedroll, rope, 3 days rations, flint)
Disciple's prayer-cord of tiny vertebrae (taken from his one kill)
Map of the Weeping Valley, hand-drawn from dreams
features: Hearthblood: you dream Aldrumm's dreams. Marrow warms and brightens in your presence. Once per long rest, ask the GM one question about the god's body or past and get a true but dreamlike answer.
Second Wind (1/short rest): bonus action, regain 1d10+2 HP.
Hunter's Mark of Endings (1/short rest): bonus action, mark a creature; your weapon hits deal +1d6 to it for 1 minute. Against Choir members you also know where they are while within 60 ft.
STOLEN: The Lagging Shadow (harvested from Choir disciple Brother Quell): bonus action, step into your own shadow and out of another shadow within 30 ft you can see. +1 Carrion Rot per use.
background: Outsider from beyond the Weeping Valley
notes: Killed one Hollow Choir disciple, Brother Quell, on the Spine Road eleven days ago and ate his last breath. Has not told anyone his lineage. Followed a dream of a warm red room under a chapel to Godbones.

visual_appearance.hair: dark auburn, shoulder length, tied back with a strip of leather
visual_appearance.face: weathered and angular, short beard, an old scar through one eyebrow
visual_appearance.eyes: deep amber that glow faintly like marrow-light when he dreams or is angry
visual_appearance.clothing: travel-worn studded leather over a faded hearth-red tunic, a heavy grey road cloak
visual_appearance.gear: longsword on the hip, hunting knife at the boot, a prayer-cord of tiny vertebrae wound around his left wrist, cracked marrow lamp on his pack
visual_appearance.demeanor: quiet, watchful, carries himself like someone owed a debt by the world
